annotation.title_clean: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.title_en: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology; Ministry of Justice (Office of Legal Counsel and Legislative Affairs)
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: English summary of Israel's December 2023 first AI regulation and ethics policy for the private sector. It identifies seven challenges (discrimination, oversight, explainability, disclosure, safety, accountability, privacy) and recommends sectoral, risk-based, soft-law regulation, international alignment, public-private cooperation and a coordination center.
key_provisions_or_claims: Empower sector-specific regulators rather than a single horizontal AI law
Adopt a risk-based approach with incremental soft regulatory tools
Align with OECD and leading countries' approaches for interoperability
Establish an AI Policy Coordination Center, inter-agency and multistakeholder forums
Develop a government risk management tool with common terminology
